rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition, capital improvement, substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: For eviction notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27 on these no-fault grounds, the landlord owes $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with a minor child. Rates reset each March 1.
rules.requirement_es: Para avisos de desalojo entregados entre el 1/03/26 y el 28/02/27 por estas causas sin culpa del inquilino, el propietario debe pagar $8,245 por inquilino, hasta $24,733 por unidad, más $5,497 por cada inquilino mayor (60+) o discapacitado o hogar con menores. Las tarifas se actualizan cada 1 de marzo.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; $24,733 max per unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor (notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27)
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9, not § 37.9C.
rules.caveat: Archive page; amounts are adjusted annually. Citation § 37.9C inferred from the page's footnote.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: For Ellis Act eviction notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27, the landlord owes $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant. Rates reset each March 1.
rules.requirement_es: Para avisos de desalojo bajo la Ley Ellis entregados entre el 1/03/26 y el 28/02/27, el propietario debe pagar $11,110.05 por inquilino, hasta $33,330.13 por unidad, más $7,443.90 por cada inquilino mayor (62+) o discapacitado. Las tarifas se actualizan cada 1 de marzo.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; $33,330.13 max per unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly/disabled tenant (notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27)
rules.caveat: Archive page; amounts adjusted annually. The page does not state the code section; § 37.9A is inferred.
